reviewers.summary: The manuscript fails to specify a research question, lacks essential methodological details (variable definitions, missing data handling, PCA pre-processing and diagnostic checks), and provides no interpretation of results. The analysis is unbound and exploratory, and claims of 'interpretable local evidence' are unsupported. The paper does not meet minimum reporting standards for a scientific study.

findings.title: Prespecified study question is never stated
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md#Abstract: Objective: 'What does the analyzed dataset show for the prespecified study question?'
manuscript.md#Introduction: 'This analysis asks: What does the analyzed dataset show for the prespecified study question?'
findings.whyItMatters: Without a defined research question, the entire analysis has no purpose, design, or interpretable outcome. It is impossible to assess alignment between methods and goals.
findings.actionableFix: Clearly articulate the specific clinical or psychometric question (e.g., 'Do the three scale items form a unidimensional scale?'). Link every methodological choice to this question.

findings.title: Variable definitions and measurement properties are missing
findings.whyItMatters: Interpretation of PCA loadings requires knowing what each variable measures, its scale type, range, and theoretical relationship to the construct. Without this, the components are meaningless.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a data dictionary with variable labels, measurement scales, possible ranges, and any psychometric history (e.g., from a validated questionnaire). Report descriptive statistics.

findings.title: Missing data handling and complete-case justification not reported
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md#Cohort Construction: 'The complete-case sample size was 240.'
findings.whyItMatters: Complete-case analysis can introduce bias if missingness is not completely at random. The original sample size, amount of missing data, and patterns are unknown.
findings.actionableFix: Report initial sample size, number and percentage of missing per variable, and missingness patterns. Discuss potential bias and consider sensitivity analyses (e.g., multiple imputation) or justify MCAR assumption.

findings.title: PCA pre-processing and factorability assessment not reported
findings.whyItMatters: PCA assumptions (adequate sample size, sufficient correlations among items) must be checked. Standardization of variables is critical. No correlation matrix, KMO, or Bartlett's test is shown, making results uninterpretable.
findings.actionableFix: Report the correlation matrix, KMO measure (>0.6), Bartlett's test (p<0.05). State whether variables were standardized. Provide scree plot or parallel analysis to support component retention.

findings.title: No interpretation of principal components
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-run.json: estimates show variance explained but no component interpretation
findings.whyItMatters: A PCA is useless if the retained components are not interpreted in terms of the underlying construct. Readers cannot understand what the analysis reveals.
findings.actionableFix: Decide on number of components to retain (e.g., based on eigenvalue >1, scree plot, parallel analysis). Label each retained component based on the pattern of high loadings. Discuss if they align with theory.

findings.title: Unbound exploratory result used for unsupported claims
findings.whyItMatters: An unbound, exploratory analysis cannot support confirmatory or generalizable conclusions. Claim language must reflect this limitation explicitly.
findings.actionableFix: Either bind the analysis to a pre-registered protocol via an AnalysisSpec and re-run, or restrict conclusions to 'hypothesis-generating only'. Remove any implication of method-governed inference.

findings.title: Insufficient information for independent reproduction
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md#Reproducibility: mentions artifact inventory but not raw data or code
stats-run/stats-run.json: only output files, no input data or script
findings.whyItMatters: Scientific integrity requires that results be independently verifiable. Without data, code, and exact analysis steps, this is not possible.
findings.actionableFix: Provide the fully de-identified dataset (or a synthetic version) and the complete analysis script (e.g., R/Python) that produced all outputs. Include seed if any randomization used.

findings.title: Abstract and manuscript are generic boilerplate, lacking study-specific content
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript reads like a template filled with placeholders (e.g., 'The complete-case analytic sample included 240 records.' as the sole result). It fails as a scientific communication.
findings.actionableFix: Replace generic sections with specific details: background rationale, hypothesis, methods, full results with interpretation, and limitations tied to the actual data and analysis.

missingEvidence: Variable definitions, measurement scales, and theoretical justification
Descriptive statistics (means, SD, ranges) for all variables
Missing data report: initial N, percent missing per variable, missingness patterns
Correlation matrix among the four variables
Kaiser‑Meyer‑Olkin (KMO) measure of sampling adequacy and Bartlett's test of sphericity
Standardization method applied to variables before PCA
Scree plot or parallel analysis results justifying number of components retained
Interpretation and labeling of retained principal components
Raw de-identified data file and analysis script/code
Ethics approval statement (if human subjects data)

reviewers.summary: The manuscript lacks essential reporting of PCA results, study objectives, and methodological justifications. The analysis is exploratory and unbound, yet presented with ambiguous claims. Key diagnostic and missing-data information is absent, and reproducibility is hampered by incomplete artifact access.

findings.title: No PCA results reported
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript's Results section contains only sample size; none of the PCA explained variance ratios or component loadings are presented or interpreted, making the study uninformative.
findings.actionableFix: Report the explained variance for each principal component, loadings, and possibly a scree plot interpretation. Discuss the structure and whether it suggests a single scale.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript contains numeric PCA estimates and a textual description of the factor structure.

findings.title: Ambiguous role of variable 'severity' in PCA
findings.whyItMatters: Including an outcome variable (severity) with scale items in a PCA without justification could conflate distinct constructs and mislead interpretation. The study question is unclear, so the appropriateness of this variable selection cannot be evaluated.
findings.actionableFix: Clarify whether 'severity' is an indicator of the same latent construct or an external criterion. If the goal is scale validation, consider separate analyses (e.g., PCA on items only, then correlation with severity).
findings.deterministicVerification: Review analysis plan to confirm variable roles and justification for inclusion in PCA.

findings.title: Missing PCA adequacy diagnostics
findings.whyItMatters: PCA requires assessing sampling adequacy (e.g., KMO, Bartlett's test), communalities, and inter-item correlations. Their absence leaves the suitability of PCA unverified.
findings.actionableFix: Provide and report a correlation matrix, KMO measure, Bartlett's test of sphericity, and possibly an anti-image correlation matrix. Discuss whether data are suitable for PCA.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of KMO > 0.6 and significant Bartlett’s test (p < 0.05) in diagnostics.

findings.title: Missing-data handling not described
findings.whyItMatters: The analysis uses 240 complete cases, but no information is given about initial sample size, exclusion criteria, or missingness patterns. Selective complete-case analysis can bias results if missingness is non-random.
findings.actionableFix: Report the starting number of records, number and percentage of cases excluded due to missing data, and any sensitivity analyses performed.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check for a flow diagram or table describing subject exclusions and missing data.

findings.title: Unbound exploratory analysis presented with ambiguous certainty
findings.whyItMatters: The stats-run is 'unbound', i.e., not governed by a pre-specified analysis plan, and marked as exploratory. Yet the manuscript uses language like 'interpretable local evidence' and 'prespecified study question' without sufficient transparency on its exploratory nature.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly label the analysis as exploratory and not confirmatory. Remove any implication of generalizability or clinical recommendation unless a protocol and binding are in place.
findings.deterministicVerification: Inclusion of a statement like 'This is an exploratory analysis without pre-registration; results are hypothesis-generating only.'

findings.title: Incomplete artifact accessibility undermines reproducibility
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript and provided artifacts do not give clear access to the raw data, transformation code, or intermediate outputs (e.g., pca-transformed.csv, estimates.csv). The inventory lists files but they are not available for review, making independent verification impossible.
findings.actionableFix: Include all artifacts in the review packet or provide a public repository link. At minimum, supply the PCA-transformed dataset, correlation matrix, and config details.
findings.deterministicVerification: All referenced reproducible artifacts are accessible to the reviewer.

findings.title: Contradictory statement about missing paper artifact
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript's limitations state 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found,' which is self-contradictory and suggests a template error, reducing the document's professionalism.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or correct the conflicting statement.
findings.deterministicVerification: The phrase no longer appears in the manuscript.

missingEvidence: Prespecified study question and variable roles
Correlation matrix and PCA adequacy tests (KMO, Bartlett's)
Initial sample size before complete-case filtering
Code or configuration for PCA execution

reviewPanel.nextAction: Adjudicate findings and route accepted repairs back into the pipeline.
